text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PD-3921 triggered for service=redwood-inference--inference-api (urgency: high). Primary on-call paged. Symptoms: spike in 5xx and elevated p95 latency in eu-west region. Link: <https://pagerduty.example/PD-3921>
alex: Acked on PD, taking the lead. Investigating 5xx surge.
morgan: I got the secondary page — stuck in mobile DND initially, sorry. If primary doesn't ack PD will escalate. I'm available now.
devon: +1 on standby. If this looks like cache/backpressure we should consider routing to standby region.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Escalation policy fired for PD-3921 — paging secondary (morgan) then manager (kim) in 4m if no ack.
morgan: Acked via PD. quick check — looking at proxy logs, seeing lots of 502/gateway errors around 14:03 UTC and increased redis timeouts to redis-eu-1.
alex: Confirming redis latency spike coincident with errors. Hypothesis: partial outage in eu-redis cluster causing backend failures.
alex: Rolling a temporary fallback—switching cache-proxy to eu-fallback cluster.
alex: ```kubectl -n infra set env deployment/cache-proxy FALLBACK_CLUSTER=eu-fallback
kubectl rollout restart deploy/cache-proxy -n infra``` 
kim: (escalated) On my way. What's the customer impact now?
alex: After switching, initial metrics show ~30% drop in 5xxs and p95 improving. Still seeing a handful of timeouts for large payloads.
morgan: CS flagged several premium customers seeing delayed embeddings and streaming timeouts; ticket #CS-98342 created.
devon: Suggest routing ~80% traffic to eu-standby to reduce error exposure (adds ~30-50ms latency but prevents failures).
kim: Approve routing plan. @networking to prepare failover route. Prioritize preserving availability.
alex: Applying weighted route: ```reroute --from eu-primary --to eu-standby --weight 80 --dry-run=false``` — running now.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-3921 updated — acknowledged by morgan/alex; status=investigating.
morgan: Post-route metrics: 5xx rates back to normal for most tenants. One large customer still reports intermittent timeouts; opened hotfix task with runtime/model team.
devon: If the customer issue persists we'll do a controlled rollback of the recent model-runtime change in eu. Preparing rollback playbook.
kim: Good containment. Assigning alex as incident lead and morgan as secondary for the RCA. Please capture timeline, mitigations, and any required follow-ups for CS and infra.
alex: Will draft incident summary and start a doc in #incidents. ETA 2 hours. (reacted with :eyes: by kim)
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-3921 status set to "mitigated" by alex. Please confirm when fully resolved.
morgan: Confirmed mitigations holding for 20+ mins. Leaving thread for alex to finalize the postmortem.
